request.description:
`version`'s request: it has no fields. It takes no session, so its response's `session`
is null.
request.title: VersionRequest

Length.description: A length in millimetres: a number, to at most 6 decimals (nanometres). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

Limits.description:
The limits every command holds to (the design's section 6), each the value the commands
use. A request past one is refused, as `invalid_input`, unless its description says
otherwise.

document_bytes.description:
The most bytes a document's canonical text may be: past it, an edit, a commit, or an
`open` is refused.

elements.description: The most entries an `elements` call lists: its `limit` at most.

export_bytes.description:
The most bytes one `3mf` export's archive may be (a plain zip's, with no ZIP64):
past it, refused, naming `tolerance`.

export_tolerance.description: The least and the most tolerance a `3mf` export takes, in millimetres.

export_triangles.description:
The most triangles one `3mf` export writes, every part's in all: past it, refused,
naming `tolerance`.

kernel_seconds.description:
How long one request to a kernel worker may take, in seconds: past it, the worker is
stopped, a `worker_timeout`, which is the machine's fault, never the document's.

listed.description:
How many errors (or problems, or warnings) a response lists: the rest are counted,
never refused.

log_bytes.description:
The most text a session's log buffer keeps, in bytes, counted as a read counts it:
not refused, the oldest events are dropped and counted.

log_events.description:
The most events a session's log buffer keeps: not refused, the oldest are dropped
and counted (`read_logs`' `dropped`).

log_read_bytes.description:
The most text one `read_logs` returns, in bytes (its events' messages, spans, and
features): a read stops before the event that would pass it, its `next` saying where.

log_read_events.description: The most events one `read_logs` returns: its `limit` at most.

published_reads.description: How many reads of the published model run at once in one session.

query.description: The most entries a `query` returns: its `limit` at most.

query_measures.description: The most ranges a `query`'s `measures` holds: one a measure.

render_seconds.description:
How long one render may take, in seconds: past it, the render worker is stopped, a
`worker_timeout`, which is the machine's fault, never the document's.

render_side.description: The most pixels a `render`'s image is across or high.

request_bytes.description: The most bytes a request may be, or a document's file `open` reads.

request_depth.description: How deeply a request's values (or a document's) may nest.

response_bytes.description: The most bytes a response may be: a command whose result would pass it is refused.

sessions.description: How many sessions one process holds open at once.

sketch_seconds.description: How long one sketch's solve may take, in seconds: past it, a `worker_timeout`.

undo_bytes.description:
The most bytes a transaction's undo stack holds, counted as `status`'s
`transaction.bytes` counts them: not refused, the oldest states after the one the
transaction began from are dropped and counted (`transaction.dropped`), and undo then
stops at the oldest kept; `rollback` still returns to the start.

api.description:
The API's version: ask for it first. One more for each change to a shape that an
older client could misread.

format.description: The document format's version, a document's `silico`.

naming.description: The naming scheme every element's name is in, a document's `naming`.
